title: Clearstream Gains CSSF Control-Agent Authorization for Tokenized Fund Shares
why_it_matters: The authorization gives established fund operators a regulated route to add tokenized share classes without replacing their existing administrators, custodians or depositaries.
caption:
RWA WIRE // FUND INFRASTRUCTURE

Clearstream Gains CSSF Control-Agent Authorization for Tokenized Fund Shares

Clearstream received CSSF authorization to act as a Control Agent for tokenized fund-share issuance under Luxembourg's Blockchain Law IV.
